submissions.title: OpenAI Stargate Abilene — Epoch AI Data Centers directory
submissions.note: AUDIT: the tracker's CONFIRMED-confidence POWER_MW metrics row for this project records numeric_value=300, but its own methodology text reads 'Basis: IT load. 200 MW operator-confirmed operating (Oracle, April 2026). Site target 1.2 GW,' and projects.json's confirmedMw field correctly shows 200. The 300 figure appears duplicated from a separate, correctly-recorded on-site gas-turbine row for the same project (basis: generation, not IT load — also 300 but a different quantity). Recommend correcting the CONFIRMED metrics row's numeric_value to 200 MW (basis: IT load) so the metrics table matches projects.json and the gas-turbine generation figure is not conflated with confirmed IT load — this is the facility-power-vs-IT-load error class this audit targets, manifesting here as an internal data inconsistency rather than a source mismatch.

claims.methodology: Basis: IT load. Epoch AI directory (analyst estimate, non-primary): 'In Abilene, 200MW is already operational.' Matches the project's existing projects.json confirmedMw=200 and the metrics row's own methodology text ('200 MW operator-confirmed operating, Oracle, April 2026'); the metrics.csv numeric_value field itself incorrectly reads 300, apparently duplicated from a separate on-site gas-turbine GENERATION entry for the same project. No primary source is currently cited for this fact in sources.csv — recommend sourcing the original Oracle/April 2026 confirmation directly.
